Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That's it we have from the first T20I! Zimbabwe have continued their good run of form in the shortest format and have begun this series with a victory. We have witnessed a cracker of a game and the next game is not too far away. The second T20I will be played on Sunday 31st of July. The action is all set to begin at 4.30 pm IST (11.00 am GMT). Do join us in advance for the build-up. Till then, it's goodbye!

Craig Ervine the skipper of Zimbabwe says that 200 was not in anyone's mind, but Sikandar Raza and Wesley Madhevere put on a great partnership, and they were happy to get there. Adds that they always wanted to hit the ground running. Ends by saying that they will try to give fewer extras and improve on that.

Nurul Hasan says that it was a really good game, Zimbabwe batted really well, but they need to bowl better, and he thought they gave away around 15 runs extra. Mentions that it was a really good pitch and they thought they could chase this one down. Ends by saying that they will come back stronger in the next game.

Sikandar Raza is the Player of the Match. He says that they discussed that around 170-180 around would be good, and after the start that they got, they thought it was possible to get there. Adds that it was not a 200-plus wicket, he felt 180 should have been enough, there were odd balls that stayed low, but they were pleased with getting 205 on the board.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, Zimbabwe batted brilliantly. Sikandar Raza was the star for them. He was the difference between them finishing with above 200 and around 180 and that 20-25 runs proved to be the difference in the end. An exceptional game to get this series underway!

Zimbabwe were good with the ball, barring a few no balls, they stuck to their plans and managed to find wickets at important times. Craig Ervine's captaincy was also really good as he rotated his bowlers brilliantly. Luke Jongwe was the bowler who grabbed 2 wickets in his spell. Although Richard Ngarava was expensive he bowled an excellent 19th over which probably sealed the game for Zimbabwe. Overall, Zimbabwe deserved to win as they were the better side.

The problem for the visitors was, that they kept losing wickets. Whenever the momentum seemed like shifting, they managed to lose a wicket. A few of their batters got off to starts but none could make it big. Nurul Hasan played brilliantly in his first outing as skipper. He really gave Bangladesh the belief that they could pull this off but lacked support from the other end.

A really good fight shown by Bangladesh but right from the start, we felt above 200 was going to be a huge task. The visitors though should be happy they got quite close to the total and maybe if one of their batters would have gone on to score big, the result could have been different. However, it's Zimbabwe who have come out on top and have taken a 1-0 lead in this series.
Fuller ball, outside off. Nurul Hasan knocks it down towards long off. No run taken! Zimbabwe win by 17 runs!
A fuller one, around middle. Nurul Hasan gets low and swings it away towards square leg. No run there!
A slower ball, shorter, outside off. Nurul Hasan looks to pull this one but he misses. That should be the game for Zimbabwe!

DROPPED AND SIX! Oh, dear! A length ball, around middle. Nurul Hasan heaves it high towards deep mid-wicket. Wellington Masakadza there, goes for the catch, but the ball goes through his hands and over the ropes for a biggie! 18 off 3 now!
FOUR LEG BYES! A shorter ball, down the leg side. Nurul Hasan looks to pull this one but he misses. The ball brushes off his pads and goes towards fine leg for a boundary.
A slower ball, yorker, around middle and off. Nurul Hasan drives it back to the bowler.

OUT! CAUGHT! A deserving wicket for Richard Ngarava! What an excellent penultimate over this is. He has probably secured the game for the home side. A low full toss, wide of off. Mosaddek Hossain slashes this one towards deep point. Milton Shumba there takes a good catch. 28 runs needed off the last over!
Commentary.Howout: c Milton Shumba b Richard Ngarava

Commentary.Commentary: Wide! A low full toss, wide of off. Mosaddek Hossain leaves it alone. Wide called!

A low full toss, and outside off. Nurul Hasan looks to hoick this one over mid-wicket but the ball goes off the top edge and lands in the vacant mid-wicket for a single. Singles are not going to hurt Zimbabwe!
A low full toss, wide of off again. Mosaddek Hossain reaches out to it drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Very full again, wide of off. Nurul Hasan stays in his crease and slashes this one towards point. Only a single.
Another one in the blockhole! A yorker, around off. Nurul Hasan squeezes it back to the bowler. Two dots on the trot!
A perfect delivery to start the over! A yorker, wide of off. Nurul Hasan fails to dig this one out.
A shorter ball, around off. Mosaddek Hossain walks across and miscues his scoop shot over the keeper's head. Two taken! Bangladesh needs 32 runs off 12 balls.
Lovely ball! Slower one, shorter and wide of off. Mosaddek Hossain looks to pull this but he gets undone by the lack of pace.
No ball! A high full toss, and that's gone over Mosaddek Hossain's head. No ball called! Free Hit coming up!
Good running! This is shorter and wide of off. Mosaddek Hossain pushes it off the back foot towards cover. Two taken!
On a length now, angling in, on the pads. Mosaddek Hossain tucks it towards mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Luke Jongwe drops it short now, around off. Nurul Hasan pulls it towards long on and takes a single.
SIX! Perfect start to the over for Bangladesh! An overpitched delivery, around off. Nurul Hasan stays in his crease and smashes this over long on for a biggie.
FOUR! A boundary off the Free Hit! Shorter and wide of off. Mosaddek Hossain moves across and slashes it past point for a boundary. 46 needed off 18 balls now.
NO BALL! It's another full toss, this time it's above the waist. Nurul Hasan pushes it down to long off for a run. No ball called! Free Hit coming up!
Another full toss, outside off. Mosaddek Hossain drives it past backward point for a single.
Another full toss, down the leg side. Nurul Hasan once again walks across far away and does well to get his bat on the ball. It goes towards short fine leg. A single taken!
FOUR! Nicely done! A very low full toss, wide of off. Nurul Hasan walks across and drills it straight down the ground for a cracking boundary.
Another pitched-up delivery, outside off. Mosaddek Hossain knocks it down to long off for another run.
Fuller ball, outside off. Nurul Hasan drives it down to long off for another run.

OUT! CAUGHT! Luke Jongwe grabs his second wicket and Bangladesh have lost half their side now. They are in some trouble now. A shorter ball, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to pull this one but the ball goes off the outside edge and flies high towards square leg. Regis Chakabva runs towards the ball and pouches it safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Luke Jongwe

Commentary.Commentary: Overpitched delivery, outside off. Nurul Hasan drives it down to long off for a single.
Leg bye! A shorter ball, slower in pace, on the body. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to pull this one but he misses. The ball hits him on his body and goes towards square leg. Leg bye taken!
A yorker now, around middle. Nurul Hasan digs it out towards cover for a single.
On a length now, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto dabs it towards backward point for a single.

Terrific fielding! A shorter ball, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto pulls it in the gap between deep mid-wicket and deep square leg. Wesley Madhevere runs to his left, puts in a dive, and makes an excellent stop. Two taken!
Pitches it up again, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto drills it down the ground for a single.
Fuller ball, on middle. Nurul Hasan miscues his scoop shot over the keeper's head. Only a single.
SIX! BOOM! Back-to-back sixes for Nurul Hasan! Another loopy ball, full, around middle. Nurul Hasan makes room, gets low, and once again dispatches this over deep mid-wicket for another biggie.
SIX! BANG! Fuller one, around middle. Nurul Hasan gets low and smashes this over dep mid-wicket for a biggie! Bangladesh need way more of these!
Slightly short, outside off. Nurul Hasan backs away and looks to pull this away, but he misses.
Shorter ball, around middle. Nurul Hasan steps down and hits it powerfully past the bowler. Two taken!
Full again, around middle. Nurul Hasan dances down the track and flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
SIX! Up and away! Tosses it up, full, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto dances down the track and tonks it high over mid-wicket for a biggie!
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto reverse-sweeps this one straight to the fielder at point.
Wide! Fires this one wide of off. Najmul Hossain Shanto leaves it alone.
Another back-of-a-length delivery, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Shorter ball, around middle. Nurul Hasan pushes it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Shorter and wide off. Najmul Hossain Shanto slashes it out towards cover for a boundary.
Yorker-length delivery, outside off. Nurul Hasan digs it out towards cover and he runs across to the other end.
Wide of off, shorter ball. Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts it towards sweeper cover for a run.

OUT! TAKEN! Luke Jongwe strikes now, he sends back Afif Hossain! A wicket at a good time for Zimbabwe. A shorter ball, slower one again, around off. Afif Hossain pulls this one but the ball goes off the top half of the bat. IT flies high and goes towards deep mid-wicket. Wesley Madhevere runs forward and takes a good catch. Nurul Hasan walks out to bat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Wellington Masakadza b Luke Jongwe

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter one, takes the pace of this ball, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto slaps it towards the fielder at long off. Only a single.
On a length, outside off. Afif Hossain cuts it towards cover and takes a single.
Flighted delivery, fuller ball, outside off. Afif Hossain drives it towards cover and takes a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Afif Hossain pushes it in the vacant mid-wicket region. Two taken!

Tosses it up again, full, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto advances down the track and smashes it down the ground. Wesley Madhevere from long on runs to his right, dives, and makes a good stop. His throw though just nowhere near the bowler and that allows the batter to complete three runs.
FOUR! Edgy runs! Tosses it up, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to go over cover but the ball goes off the outside edge away from the keeper towards third man for a boundary.
Loopy ball. Najmul Hossain Shanto steps down the pitch and yorks himself. He plays it back to the bowler.
Fuller ball, quick and around off. Afif Hossain taps it towards cover and takes a single.
Another shorter one, wide of off. Najmul Hossain Shanto cuts it towards point.
Wide of off this time, shorter delivery. Afif Hossain reaches out to it and dabs it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A low full toss on the pads. Afif Hossain steps down the pitch and flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Pitches it up, outside off. Afif Hossain drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Wide! Shorter one, outside off. Afif Hossain leaves it alone.
Another yorker, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto digs it out towards cover for a single.
A yorker-length delivery, slower one, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to drive this but he misses.
A single to end! 13 in the over but a wicket in it! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one. 120 needed now in the last 10. They need to go at 12 per over.
Afif Hossain comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Six and out and Raza gets his revenge! He slides this one a touch fuller, it is on middle, Anamul Haque goes for the slog sweep again but does not get the elevation he wanted. Holes out to the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Bangladesh in deep trouble now. Another 121 needed.
Commentary.Howout: c Milton Shumba b Sikandar Raza

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Bang! This was needed for Anamul Haque! This should get him going now! 12 from the over with two balls to go. Massive hit! On middle, Haque brings out the slog sweep and it sails over the mid-wicket fence.
Really good comeback! A yorker, it is jammed down to long on for one.
FOUR! Welcome, welcome boundary! Bangladesh need a lot more! Shanto comes down, makes it into a full toss and hits it wide of long on for a boundary.
Shorter and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Just the 4 from the over then! Outstanding from Williams! On off, this is pushed to cover for one. Run rate needed over 12 now.
On middle, this is pushed back towards the bowler.
Now a dot! Pressure building. Fired on the pads, Haque swings but it hits the pad and then hits the keeper.
Shanto comes down the track and looks to heave it on the leg side, it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket. Just the one.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Just the one again! Bangladesh need boundaries! Shorter and on off, this is guided to point for one.
Two to end so no boundaries in the last two overs! 137 needed in 12 overs. On middle, this is heaved through mid-wicket, in the gap so two taken.
Dots are gold! On off, fired in, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Just the one again! On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
Just another one! On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for another single.
Shorter and outside off, this is played through point for one.
Najmul Hossain Shanto is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, dear! What just happened there? A bizarre way for Litton Das to go back to the pavilion. But Zimbabwe have a breakthrough. A big blow for Bangladesh. Coming to the ball - A fuller ball, around off. Litton Das shuffles across and tries to scoop this over short fine leg. But the ball lobs up and goes straight to the fielder there. Richard Ngarava there drops a dolly of a catch. Meanwhile, the non-striker leaves his ground for a single. Litton Das reacts very late and leaves his crease for the run. Richard Ngarava picks up the ball quickly after dropping the catch and throws it straight to Sean Williams, who walks to the stumps at the non-striker's end and removes the bails off. Litton Das is nowhere near the crease. The third umpire checks it and gives it out and rightly so.
There is some confusion about the wicket! The umpires have taken it upstairs to the third umpire.
Shorter ball, around off. Litton Das cuts it towards point.
On the pads now, shorter ball. Anamul Haque flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Anamul Haque drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Fuller ball again, around middle and off. Litton Das pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Sean Williams begins with a fuller one, on the pads. Anamul Haque flicks it towards square leg for a single.

Leg bye! An appeal there for LBW, but turned down! A length ball, angling in, around the leg pole. Anamul Haque looks to flick he misses. The ball goes off his pads towards point. A leg bye taken! That was sliding down leg. Bangladesh are 60 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay!
Fuller ball, around off. Litton Das pushes it towards mid off for a quick single.
Swing and a miss! A shorter one, outside off. Litton Das steps down the pitch and looks to pull this over but he misses.
Another length delivery, outside off. Litton Das taps it towards cover.
On a length now, outside off. Anamul Haque dabs it towards cover and takes a single.
SIX! Anamul Haque takes full adavnatge of the Free Hit! An overpitched delivery. around middle. Anamul Haque dispatches this one straight down the ground all the way for a biggie!
Wide! Too short, outside off. Anamul Haque leaves it alone. Wide called!

NO BALL AND FOUR LEG BYES! A length ball, on the pads. Anamul Haque looks to flick this but he misses. The ball brushes off his pads and goes away from the keeper towards fine leg for a boundary. Tanaka Chivanga has overstepped here as well. No ball called! Free Hit coming up!

FOUR! Another boundary in the over! This is a good shot from Das! A fuller one, around middle and leg. Litton Das steps down the pitch and flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary. 21 runs off the over!
FIVE WIDES! Too short this time, wide of off. Litton Das leaves it alone. The keeper fails to get there as well. The ball races away towards the third man fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Edgy runs! A very full ball, around the leg pole. Litton Das makes room and tries to flick this one but the ball goes off his inside edge away from the keeper towards fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Back of a length, around middle and off. Litton Das pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

In the air...and just short! A shorter ball once again, around off. Litton Das looks to pull this away, but the ball goes off the top edge towards third man. The fielder there runs forward and puts in a dive but the ball falls just short of him. Two taken!
Leg bye! A slower ball, shorter in length, on the body. Anamul Haque looks to pull but he misses. The ball hits him on his chest and it goes towards point. Leg bye taken!
Another quick single! Pitches it up, around off. Litton Das dabs it towards cover and scampers across to the other end.
Fuller ball, outside off. Anamul Haque drives it to the fielder at cover.
Loopy ball, outside off, fuller one. Litton Das sweeps it towards square leg for a single.

FOUR! Streaky boundary! Wellington Masakadza sees Litton Das advancing down the track he follows him and serves a fuller ball. Litton Das looks to flick this away but he gets a slight inside edge away from the keeper towards fine leg for a boundary.
Spinning away, wide of off, shorter one. Litton Das cuts it towards cover-point.
On the pads, fuller ball. Litton Das tucks it towards square leg. No run there!
Shorter, quicker, around off. Anamul Haque cuts it towards point and takes a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Fuller ball, around off. Litton Das drives it uppishly over cover for a boundary.
Tight single there! Fuller now, outside off. Anamul Haque pushes it towards mid off and scampers across to the other end. The fielder there has a shy at the non-striker's end but he misses.
Outside off, on a length. Litton Das dabs it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Crunched! A shorter one again, around off. Litton Das pulls this towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Wide! Shorter and wide of off. Litton Das shuffles across and tries to scoop this away but he misses. Wide called!
Outside off, shorter ball. Anamul Haque taps it towards cover for a single.

A huge shout for caught behind, but the umpire says no! A shorter ball, down the leg side. Anamul Haque looks to pull this away, but the ball goes off his thigh pad and towards the keeper. Good decision from the umpire!
Tanaka Chivanga comes into the attack.
Full and around middle and leg. Anamul Haque pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Anamul Haque leans forward and blocks it towards square leg.
Shorter one, outside off. Anamul Haque cuts it towards cover-point.
Anamul Haque walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! Wellington Masakadza draws first blood! Zimbabwe have got an early breakthrough! This is just the start they needed. Wellington Masakadza gets rid of Munim Shahriar here. Tosses this up, full, outside off. Munim Shahriar looks to go over mid off, but the ball goes off the outside edge towards point. Tanaka Chivanga there takes a good cath.
Commentary.Howout: c Tanaka Chivanga b Wellington Masakadza

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter now, outside off, spinning away. Munim Shahriar makes room and cuts it towards point.
A fuller one, outside off. Munim Shahriar gets low and looks to sweep this one away but he misses.
Who will bowl from the other end? Wellington Masakadza it is!
Very full, on the pads. Munim Shahriar flicks it away towards square leg for a single. 5 runs off the first over!
A length ball, around off. Munim Shahriar steps down the pitch, makes room slices it uppishly over cover. Two taken!
Shorter one this time, outside off. Munim Shahriar sways away from it.
On a length again, darting it on the thigh pad. Litton Das tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single. Litton Das is off the mark as well!
Good-length delivery, angling in, around middle and leg. Munim Shahriar tucks it towards square leg for a single. Bangladesh and Munim Shahriar are up and running!
Richard Ngarava begins with a length ball, around off. Munim Shahriar taps it towards cover off the back foot.
